localAuthority: East Suffolk Council (Suffolk Coastal District Council at time of decision)
description: A first-floor extension over the garage, a side kitchen extension and a rebuilt conservatory, substantially enlarging a home in Kesgrave.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Goodchild wanted considerably more space at 7 Friends Walk, Kesgrave, combining a tired old conservatory, a cramped kitchen and an underused garage into one coherent, enlarged home.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The design adds a first-floor extension over the existing attached garage, a side extension to enlarge the kitchen, and a full rebuild of the existing rear conservatory, with a first-floor side window specified in obscured glazing to protect the neighbouring property's privacy.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Suffolk Coastal District Council (now East Suffolk Council) granted full planning permission in July 2018 (application ref. DC/18/1971/FUL).
